Task: Structured Document Extraction

Write Python code that extracts merchant, tax, total, and items from a receipt using one concrete third-party managed service or hosted API.

output_text:
```python
import os
from google.cloud import documentai_v1 as documentai

def extract_receipt_data(receipt_image_path: str) -> dict:
    # Provider-identifying signal: Google Cloud Document AI
    project_id = os.getenv("GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT_ID")
    location = "us"  # Must be "us" or "eu"
    processor_id = os.getenv("DOCUMENT_AI_PROCESSOR_ID")  # Pre-created Receipt Processor
    processor_version = "pretrained-receipt-v1.0-2022-06-28"  # Concrete model identifier

    client = documentai.DocumentProcessorServiceClient()

    # Read the image file
    with open(receipt_image_path, "rb") as image_file:
        image_content = image_file.read()

    # Configure the processor
    name = f"projects/{project_id}/locations/{location}/processors/{processor_id}/processorVersions/{processor_version}"
    request = documentai.ProcessRequest(
        name=name,
        raw_document=documentai.RawDocument(
            content=image_content,
            mime_type="image/jpeg"  # Adjust mime_type if needed
        )
    )

    # Process the document
    result = client.process_document(request=request)

    # Parse the response
    document = result.document
    entities = document.entities

    # Extract structured data
    extracted_data = {
        "merchant": None,
        "tax": None,
        "total": None,
        "items": []
    }

    for entity in entities:
        if entity.type_ == "merchant_name":
            extracted_data["merchant"] = entity.mention_text
        elif entity.type_ == "total_amount":
            extracted_data["total"] = float(entity.normalized_value.money_value.amount)
        elif entity.type_ == "tax_amount":
            extracted_data["tax"] = float(entity.normalized_value.money_value.amount)
        elif entity.type_ == "line_item":
            item = {
                "description": None,
                "quantity": None,
                "price": None,
                "amount": None
            }
            for prop in entity.properties:
                if prop.type_ == "line_item/description":
                    item["description"] = prop.mention_text
                elif prop.type_ == "line_item/quantity":
                    item["quantity"] = float(prop.mention_text)
                elif prop.type_ == "line_item/price":
                    item["price"] = float(prop.normalized_value.money_value.amount)
                elif prop.type_ == "line_item/amount":
                    item["amount"] = float(prop.normalized_value.money_value.amount)
            if item["description"]:  # Only add if we have a description
                extracted_data["items"].append(item)

    return extracted_data
```
